newsitem.title: USA: Xplor to buy private oil co, other assets.
newsitem.headline: Xplor to buy private oil co, other assets.

text.p: Xplor Corp Tuesday said it agreed in principle to acquire an unidentified privately held oil and gas company, and buy additional oil and gas properties from a larger unidentified publicly-held oil and gas company for shares of Xplor common stock.

Xplor said it will have, upon completion of both the merger and property acquisition, estimated proved reserves of 13,500 million cubic feet equivalent (MMcfe) and a significant inventory of exploration and development properties.

At the deals' completion, it is expected that the current stockholders of Xplor will own about 21 percent of the shares of Xplor, the stockholders of the private company to be merged with Xplor will own about 58 percent, and the publicly-held company selling the additional properties will own about 21 percent.
Completion of the transactions is subject to, among other things, finalization of definitive documentation and approvals by the boards of directors of the respective parties.
Xplor is an independent oil and gas exploration, development and production company.
